question: With valid same-field evidence constructed by the host, can the fixed semantic gap checker admit safe nonempty metadata compaction?
prior_turn_classification: progress: new generation trial identified evidence-reference failures and left the intended checker untested
evidence: verified_coverage v1 Middle returned invalid offsets or blank witnesses in 14/50 relations in both permitted attempts; Late returned an empty graph. It never reached semantic checking.
A uniform exact parameter-name rule on the original metadata yields 18 Middle pairs and 28 Late pairs. Potential removed characters are 1287 and 2160; these are upper bounds, not approval.

Pairs include both close paraphrases and unique qualifiers/examples. They therefore test meaningful gap judgments without constructed success labels. All matched pairs are retained in the input, not selected for likely success.
mechanism_difference: The model no longer locates evidence or proposes edits. A deterministic same-tool field join creates all candidate relationships. The unchanged checker assesses missing information using the whole original property schema, including types/enums, then the host compiles deletion only for gap-free certain rows. This removes the observed reference-generation failure and exposes the previously unexecuted semantic check.

review_integration: Use the completed independent review: citations alone do not establish truth, one version failure is not a family ban, and metadata-only methods need no successful actor episode. No extra reviewer loop.
competition_and_falsifiers: If the checker approves removal of a unique condition/example not preserved by the complete schema, the entire version fails semantic admission. All selected lines are reviewed, not a favorable subset.
If conservative feedback leaves fewer than 500 removed characters per stage, this version is too small under its predeclared feasibility gate. Do not relax it after outputs.
Safe compaction may still be irrelevant to the dominant actor workload or may remove helpful repetition. Only the conditional original SP-controlled development can test completion/product effects.
Stage-level checker responses are from the same model and have shared inputs; they are not independent validation or estimates of general checker accuracy.
minimum_execution: One checker per stage, existing one structural repair if needed and existing transport retry. Exact rules/inputs/configs/spec and independent ledger frozen first. Conditional original 10-cell development then two 30-cell blocks under unchanged gates; never promote on generation alone.
cost: Generation estimate USD 0.003–0.03, not a cap. All costs and failures retained. No new total token or expense limit.
